hook.name: MoonFlameBurnTaxHook
hook.description: Burns 5% of FLAME on buys and 10% on sells by intercepting swap deltas: sells are taxed in beforeSwap (reducing input) and buys in afterSwap (reducing output). Burned tokens are taken from the pool manager and destroyed via FLAME.burn(). Only supports exact-input swaps on a single configured FLAME/quote pool.
